main_text.p: {Os} aeternum igitur, Stephani, nunc viuite. Nam aeternum praestant viuere Pierides.
Et vos cum Stephanis aeterno foedere pacta, Et Graia & Latia viuite Pierides,
Itu quoque Musarum cultrix, Musis Stephanisque Communes colito sedula turba domos.
main_text.head: In Eam cui mortuae & iam tumulandae vivus foetus natus est, ex Valerio Max.

p.i: Salue, in anns, elate prius quam nate, sepulchrum
Cui cunas, vitam mors properata dedit,
Morrua tu vero superata morte, triumpha,
Post tua nimirum funera facta parens.
Denique tu cunctis inter celebrere maritos,
Vni cui sobolem mors homicida dedit.

main_text.head: In Romanos Vaticinos.

p.i: S I qua tibi, Romane, fides adhibenda, tyranne,
Larua tegit summi quem sacra Pontificis.
Asspiciis cuicunque tuis manus cnsta refulget,
Et capitis rufo vertice fulget apex,
Quinque vbi concepta tacito cum murmure voces

page.notes: Several words in the verse are blurred; the first lines of the first stanza are partly cut at the left edge and the initial letters are uncertain. Ornamental initial P and S are woodcut letters. The lines "Morrua" and "Vni" are doubtful readings. Headings are reconstructed from the printed lines.
